_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: In-Process Subassembly Inspection/Test Summary Report
summary: The In-Process Subassembly Inspection/Test Summary Report summarizes in-process and subassembly inspection and test data and failures for evaluating part quality during manufacture and assembly.
use_relationship:
The In-Process Subassembly Inspection/Test Summary Report is a summary of inspection and test data and all in-process and subassembly failures. Each summary report is limited to an equipment type such as space, ground, etc.

The report is used to evaluate the quality of parts during various phases of manufacture and assembly.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement for this data included in the contract.

This report is required when equipment parts are subject to in-process and subassembly testing.

This DID supercedes DI-QCIC-80375.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The In-Process Subassembly Inspection/Test Summary Report shall be provided in contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following information:

children.title: Name(s) and official title(s) of the preparer(s) of the report.
Brief introduction that includes the scope and purpose of the report.
A summary of all in-process and subassembly inspection/test data shall be listed by defect and also by subassembly and/or part.
children.content: The summary include the following information (data shall be based on "first time seen"):

children.title: Reference Failure Analysis Report (FAR) number and Nonconforming Material Report (NCMR) number.
FAR dash number (i.e., 3-2 indicates third failure of a part number and the second failure of the part number in the mode).
Quantity of each subassembly tested that month.
Quantity of each subassembly failed that month.
Percentage of Printed Wiring Assembly (PWA) requiring touch-up and top five defects.
Percentage (yield) from PWA pre-conformal coat test, in-circuit test and functional test including top five defects found during each respective test.
Percentage (yield) from PWA post-conformal coat functional test/inspection including top five defects found.
Percentage (yield) from remaining sub-assembly (cables, harnesses, etc) inspection/test including top five defects found.
Histograms which reflect the recorded variables in 3.3 above.
